newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 31.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* The ringgit retreats once again, slipping to 2.6315/25 on Thursday morning against 2.6220/50 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday.
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average hit yet another record, rising 80.36 points to 8,254.89.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was down 6.87 points to 1,024.74.
* Telekom Malaysia expected to be in focus again on rumours of less-than-expected earnings. It fell 35 cents to 9.95 ringgit on Wednesday.
* Ekran chairman Ting Pek Khiing's announcement that its differences with contractors on Bakun hydroelectric dam project is over costs could get some attention.
* Earnings trend being watched for near-term direction, dealers say
